load_atek_wds_dataset_as_efm: build a webdataset pipeline that loads ATEK data and transforms it to EFM format with configurable frequency and snippet length
load_atek_wds_dataset_as_efm_train: build a training webdataset pipeline that loads ATEK data with resampling and transforms it to EFM format
EfmModelAdaptor.atek_to_efm: create a data transform that converts ATEK webdataset samples to EFM unbatched samples with pose splitting and padding
run_local_cosy: build a function that shifts snippet coordinate system origin and transforms timestamps and poses accordingly
EfmModelAdaptor.get_dict_key_mapping_all: create a dictionary that maps all ATEK data keys to EFM data keys for pose, points, and camera fields
